examples.english: “Jesus answered and said unto Mary in the midst of the disciples: Amēn, amēn, I say unto you: The second Helper is distant from the first Helper in great immeasurable distance in regard to the height above and the depth below and the length and the breadth. For he is exceedingly distant from him in great immeasurable distance through the angels and all the archangels and through the gods and all the invisibles. And he is very considerably greater than the latter in an incalculable measure | through the angels and archangels and through the gods and all the invisibles.”
